headline: FDA Flags High-Risk Heart Device Recall At Edwards Lifesciences After Patient Death
summary: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) issued a high-risk early alert after Edwards Lifesciences Corp. (NYSE:EW) recalled specific lots of its Commander M delivery systems due to reports of balloons bursting during procedures, resulting in one death and a serious injury. headline: Edwards’ SAPIEN M3 delivery system linked to patient death in FDA alert
summary: An issue with the delivery component of Edwards’ SAPIEN M3 TMVR system has been associated with one patient death and one serious injury as of 5 October.
